root_cause: When the drawer is opened via the Enter key, focus remains on the triggering button or the body instead of moving into the dialog, preventing keyboard users from interacting with the filter controls.
repair_strategy: Modify DialogBase._showElement to move focus to the first focusable element inside the dialog after it is shown, using SelectorEngine.find for reliable querying.
expected_accessibility_effect: After opening the drawer with Enter, focus will shift to the close button (#filters-close), allowing subsequent Tab navigation to reach the In stock checkbox and other controls as expected.
functional_risks: If the dialog contains no focusable elements, focus will not be moved (guarded by length check).
Potential conflict with subclasses that implement custom focus management; however, none are present in this codebase.
verification_requirements: Pressing Enter on #filters-open results in focus on #filters-close.
Pressing Enter on #apply updates the applied filter output to 'in'.
